metas.name: 1 · ★ 4.9 · 1996 · Lilla Jönssonligan och cornflakeskuppen
metas.description: The young Jönssonligan's plan to steal "millions of filmisar" faces problem after problem before uncovering something much greater.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 4.4 · 1997 · Lilla Jönssonligan på styva linan
metas.description: It is summer holidays in the late 1950s and a fun fair comes to Wall-Entuna. All children obviously want to go there including Lilla Jönssonligan. Sickan then obviously has a plan for how to get hold of hundreds of "free tickets".

metas.name: 3 · ★ 3.2 · 2004 · Lilla Jönssonligan på kollo
metas.description: After one mischief too many, the three rasquels are sent to a summer camp on an island (run by their arch enemy Wall-Enberg). Trouble maker Sickan soon hatches a plan to get their hands on a boat loaded with sweets heading their way.

metas.name: 4 · ★ 2.8 · 2006 · Lilla Jönssonligan & stjärnkuppen
metas.description: Sickan, Vanheden and Harry are confident about getting hold of the autograph from this summer's most sought-after artist, Dani D. A unique autograph because she does not write any.
